text.heading: Biometeorološka prognoza za Srbiju za: 16.11.2026. - PONEDELJAK
text.body: Biometeorološke prilike neće pogodovati hronično obolelima. Nanjizraženije tegobe mogu imati astmatičari, reumatičari i osobe sa osetlјivim nervnim sistemom. Kod meteoropata moguća je jaka glavobolјa, umor i razdražlјivost. Neophodna je dodatna pažnja u saobraćaju.

english.heading: Biometeorological forecast: 16.11.2026. - MONDAY
english.body: Biometeorological conditions will be unfavorable for those with chronic health issues. Asthmatics, individuals with rheumatic conditions, and those with a sensitive nervous system may experience the most pronounced symptoms. People sensitive to weather changes may suffer from severe headaches, fatigue, and irritability. Extra caution is advised in traffic.

text.heading: Biometeorološka prognoza za Srbiju za: 17.11.2026. - UTORAK
text.body: Očekivana biometeorološka situacija može doprineti pojačanju tegoba kod srčanih bolesnika i osoba sa respiratornim obolјenjima. Od meteoropatskih reakcija moguća je nervoza i pospanost. U saobraćaju se savetuje dodatan oprez.

english.heading: Biometeorological forecast: 17.11.2026. - TUESDAY
english.body: The expected biometeorological conditions may lead to an intensification of symptoms in individuals with heart conditions or respiratory diseases. Possible weather-related reactions include nervousness and drowsiness. Extra caution is advised in traffic.

products.noteEn: Daily readings at the source report time. This product is separate from automatic stations. Discharge is in m³/s; stage and daily change are in cm.

products.noteSr: Prva kolona datuma je osmotren vodostaj, slede četiri prognozirana dana. Kote odbrane su referentni pragovi; ovaj prikaz ne proglašava stanje odbrane od poplava.
products.noteEn: The first date is an observation, followed by four forecast days. Defence thresholds are reference values; this view does not declare a flood defence state.

products.noteSr: Kvalitativna hidrološka tendencija. Površina sliva je u km². Simboli ne predstavljaju numeričku prognozu vodostaja.
products.noteEn: Qualitative hydrological tendencies. Basin area is in km². Symbols are not numeric stage forecasts.

products.noteSr: Originalni radarski kompozit. dBZ označava radarsku reflektivnost, a ne količinu padavina u milimetrima. Termine čitamo iz izvornih naziva datoteka u UTC. Slike se učitavaju direktno sa RHMZ-a.
products.noteEn: Original radar composite. dBZ represents radar reflectivity, not millimetres of rainfall. Frame times come from source UTC filenames. Images load directly from RHMZ.

products.noteSr: Originalne slike se učitavaju direktno sa RHMZ-a. Njihove adrese se periodično koriste ponovo: merodavan je datum i UTC termin odštampan na samoj slici, a ne vreme preuzimanja spiska. Legenda i autorska oznaka ostaju vidljive.
products.noteEn: Original images load directly from RHMZ. URLs are reused: the date and UTC time printed on the image are authoritative, rather than the time this frame list was retrieved. Legends and copyright remain visible.

text.heading: Meteorološke najave
text.body: NAJAVE RHMZ Meteorološka najava PONEDELјAK, 16.11.2026. u 11:00 h Danas umereno do potpuno oblačno, mestimično sa kišom i lokalnim plјuskovima uz više padavina u centralnim i istočnim krajevima. Duvaće slab do umeren, u košavskom području povremeno i jak jugoistočni vetar, a na jugu Banata i u donjem Podunavlјu sa udarima olujne jačine, krajem dana u slablјenju i skretanju na zapadni i jugozapadni. Najviša temperatura od 8 do 15 °S. TOPLIJE, PONEGDE I DO 23 °C, SA ČESTOM POJAVOM KIŠE Sutra ujutru mestimično magla i niska oblačnost koja će se ponegde zadržati i pre podne. Tokom dana malo do umereno oblačno sa sunčanim intervalima i toplije. Posle podne sa severa jače naoblačenje koje će uveče i tokom noći mestimično usloviti kišu. Vetar slab i umeren, na severu Vojvodine od sredine dana i jak, a u planinskim predelima jugozapadne i južne Srbije povremeno i olujni južni i jugozapadni. Najniža temperatura od 3 do 8 °S, a najviša od 15 do 21 °S. Do petka toplo sa maksimalnom temperaturom u većini mesta od 18 do 23 °S, u Negotinskoj Krajini oko 16 °S. Od subote temperatura u padu. Tokom celog perioda promenlјivo oblačno, povremeno sa kišom i lokalnim plјuskovima, a krajem perioda na visokim planinama jugozapadne i južne Srbije i sa snegom. Najava je za period od: 11:02 16.11.2026. do: 11:02 23.11.2026. Hidrološka najava Na Savi narednih dana vodostaji će biti u većem porastu bez dostizanja granica redovne odbrane od poplava. Za više detalja pogledajte: Prognoza voda Najava je za period od: 10:06 16.11.2026. do: 10:06 18.11.2026.

english.heading: Weather and hydrological advisories · 16 November 2026
english.body: RHMZ advisory, 16 November, 11:00: Today mostly cloudy with rain and local showers, heaviest in central and eastern Serbia. Southeasterly winds may be strong in the Košava area, with storm-force gusts in southern Banat and the lower Danube, easing and turning west or southwest late in the day. Highs: 8–15 °C. Tuesday starts with local fog and low cloud, followed by brighter, warmer weather; rain spreads from the north late. Southerly and southwesterly winds strengthen in northern Vojvodina, with occasional storm-force winds on southwestern and southern mountains. Lows: 3–8 °C; highs: 15–21 °C. Until Friday, highs are mostly 18–23 °C, around 16 °C in Negotin; cooling follows from Saturday. Rain and showers recur, with late-period snow on high southern and southwestern mountains. Weather advisory validity: 16 November 11:02 to 23 November 11:02. Sava stages are expected to rise substantially while remaining below regular flood-defence thresholds. Hydrological advisory validity: 16 November 10:06 to 18 November 10:06. All times are Europe/Belgrade.
